title: Avoid invoking skill authoring for an ordinary one-off prompt
prompt: Write me a one-time prompt I can paste into Codex to rename a local variable. Do not create or change any reusable skill.
expected_behaviors: Recognize that the user requested a one-off prompt rather than a reusable skill.
Do not invoke the full skill-authoring workflow or create evaluation artifacts.
Provide the requested prompt directly, keeping its scope limited to the local variable rename.
must_not: Create or edit a SKILL.md file.
Create evaluation cases or a quality rubric for this one-off request.
Expand the task into toolkit maintenance.
